title: Black Off-Shoulder Knit & Leather Wrap Skirt
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy black hair stands against a white backdrop. She wears a black ribbed off-shoulder knit top with a row of purple buttons down one sleeve, over a sheer printed mesh bodice. A purple orchid sits at her throat. A distressed brown leather wrap mini skirt with eyelet laces and a studded hem completes the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of black, plum, and burnt brown. Edgy and textured, in the style of a grunge editorial lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The off-shoulder knit and leather wrap skirt are the key textures.
- Keep the orchid as a single accent for contrast.
